title: console_order_written event payload v0.2 (PLAN-FIRST stage C action bar)
description: ADR-0010 §14.17 / PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §5-§6: the blackboard_action_write order record. The order identity, action, step binding, and the mechanical round/plan_epoch/run_id stamps live HERE (Schema-first, 2026-08-16); the action_write ToolCompleted converges to the generic contract shape (success = exit_code only) — resolving the S2 payload-shape debt registered in the stage-A audit §7.4. step_id binds the order to a plan step (ActionOrder.step_id); the issuance-time step gate enforces pending → in_progress → done/failed.

write_call_id.description: The blackboard_action_write ToolCompleted call_id this order record closes — the producer emits the write completion first, then this order record carrying the same call_id (verifier cross-check; 2026-08-16 review closure F1).

step_id.description: The plan step this order executes (ActionOrder.step_id). Null when no structured plan is in force.
